WAITING FOR THE DRIVER
TO PICK A STAGE

<color=#998050>DRIVER</color>     steers the wreck
<color=#998050>NAVIGATOR</color>  calls the turns

notes: Original native uGUI MainMenu under MenuCanvas; separate from the extension IMGUI DirectSession overlay.
Most menu and tablet labels use the exact exported Share Tech Mono font. Header sizes18px, primary START38px, secondary buttons26px.
Tablet casing RectTransform560x720 at1.12scale, left-middle anchored[1130,0], rotation0 on1920x1080MenuFrame.
TabletRound128px sprite has40px nine-slice borders; native button pixelsPerUnitMultiplier4 makes10px effective corners, casing.8 makes50px corners.
ee.png is the original transparent car-and-crews illustration. No new artwork or scenery is generated.

title.note: White alpha title mask composed from original baked font glyph pixels and metrics; tint with nativeTextColor. Source has no embedded Anton TTF.
